This is a teaching repo for aspiring AI engineers. Explain in plain language first, then show code. Keep code small and readable. All model calls go through `shared/llm.py` (`ask_llm`); never hard-code a provider in a lesson. Never print or commit API keys (they live in `.env`). When a prompt or schema changes, suggest updating the eval cases. Follow the lesson folder structure: README.md, starter/, prompts/, evals/, exercises.md.
